test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following States hosted the three-day Civil Air Navigation Services Organisation (CANSO) Conference from 1st to 3rd November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Goa** hosted the three day **Civil Air Navigation Services Organisation (CANSO) **Conference from **1st to 3rd November 2022**. 
 
• Delegates and exhibitors from the Asia Pacific region and beyond gathered to discuss and collaborate on key issues shaping the future of Asia’s aviation industry and turning the **Complete Air Traffic System **(CATS) **Global Council’s vision for the skies of 2045 into a reality**.
 
• “**Think Global, Collaborate Regional, Accomplish Local**” is the theme of this year’s conference.
 
• Conference also covers **digitization and automation as key enablers **in delivering CANSO’s vision for future skies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **CANSO **(Civil Air Navigation Services Organisation) is the **global voice **of the **air traffic management **(ATM) industry.
 
• It is shaping our future skies.
 
• Its members support over **90% of the world’s air traffic **and include air navigation service providers, airspace users and operators, manufacturers and aviation industry suppliers.
 
• The organization looks on global Air Traffic Management performance by **connecting the industry to share knowledge, expertise and innovation**.
